name: Geidel Guerra
title: Software Developer / Tech Solutions
about:
I'm a generalist developer with a genuine curiosity for how things work, which keeps me comfortable moving across languages, stacks, and problem domains. Over more than a decade I've built tech solutions ranging from SaaS platforms and e-commerce systems to command-line tools, browser extensions, and CI/deployment pipelines.

Lately my focus has been on SaaS solutions for both B2B and B2C products, AI integrations, DevOps, and hardware integrations, connecting APIs, microcontrollers, and scanners into practical business tools. I enjoy turning ambiguous problems into reliable, working software.

experience.name: Senior Software Developer
experience.description: Gourmet ice company in Miami, FL. Building a warehouse management system (orders, inventory, customers, delivery routes) and a drivers' delivery mobile app, plus automation tools that integrate APIs, microcontrollers, and scanners.

experience.name: Co-Founder / Developer
experience.description: Workforce management SaaS for marketing agencies. As Lead Developer/CTO, I own all technical decisions and solely built the MVP: HTMX + vanilla JS frontend, Laravel + SQLite backend, with CRUD forms, reports, and ChartJs dashboards. Hosted on Digital Ocean behind Cloudflare, with a Docker Compose + GitHub Actions pipeline publishing to GitHub Container Registry.

experience.name: Senior Software Developer
experience.description: Hotel management tech company, including secure digital lock installations. Set up unit testing foundations for their core platform, integrated AI into support email/chat channels, and built a browser extension adding AI to their review responses. Also prototyped an AWS Textract + Python invoice automation service (later discarded). Stack: PHP (Yii, Laravel), Python (Flask, FastAPI).

experience.name: CTO / Senior Software Developer
experience.description: Digital marketing agency in Spain. Started as Full Stack developer building a multi-tenant internal SaaS (Laravel, MySQL, Vue.js + Inertia.js) with a multi-database architecture and integrations for Facebook, LinkedIn, X, and Google; set up deployment via Laravel Forge/Envoyer, later migrated to Vapor. Promoted to CTO, owning all tech decisions and mentoring new hires while leading a second SaaS: a chart-heavy social media analytics tool (Laravel Vapor, Vue.js, Inertia.js).
